parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by an *ideal gas*.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: An ideal gas comprised of single atoms is contained in a cylinder and has a volume of $1.84 \times 10^{-2} \text{m}^3$ at a pressure of $2.12 \times 10^7 \text{Pa}$. The mass of gas in the cylinder is $3.20 \text{kg}$.
parts.text: Determine, to three significant figures, the root-mean-square (r.m.s.) speed of the atoms of the gas.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
(b)(ii)1 The temperature of the gas in the cylinder is $22^{\circ}\text{C}$. Determine, to three significant figures,

1. the amount, in mol, of the gas,

(b)(ii)2 2. the mass of one atom of the gas.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Use your answer in **(b)(ii) part 2** to determine the nucleon number $A$ of an atom of the gas.
